prompts.name: diagonal_ne
prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: single fallen-log obstacle sprite for a cute top-down Goryeo trading RPG. Reference image is the ORIGINAL short chunky log, NOT the longer rejected v2. Match the original rounded sturdy proportions, pale golden circular cut end, chestnut bark, dark brown chunky outline, broad simple bark grooves, 2-3 flat shades, a couple of tiny snapped branch stubs. Keep it compact, suitable for a 48x48 native pixel sprite at PPU16; not thin, not stretched. Ground-plane orientation changes, camera stays looking down at the same gentle 3/4 angle; no standing upright tree, no rotating the old picture. Redraw as one whole intact fallen log, diameter remains generous, broad readable clusters, no noise/gradient/shadow/scenery/text. Fully transparent background, generous margin, one object only, no sheet. The trunk lies DIAGONALLY across the ground from lower-left to upper-right at 45 degrees. A visible cut end at the lower-left foreground, broken end at the upper-right. Bark shading and cut-end ellipse make this a horizontal fallen object lying on the ground. Main axis goes lower left to upper right.
